The best bet is likely to wait. He certainly sounds either hurt or angry or possibly some combination of both. I agree with @yousmell_likedog that you're probably better served to really dig into the emotions that caused you to send the e-mail in the first place. Even if this relationship doesn't work out, it may lead to more positive relationships down the road.

If he's still interested in you, he'll contact you. Give him a few days, try to focus on something else in the mean time. Text messages are probably not the best way to communicate that you're leaving someone or want to get back together, they don't indicate tone of voice. A phone call or meeting in person would probably be better, unless this is a particularly upsetting issue for you. Crying might make him hesitant to re-enter a relationship.

He was probably confused about why you broke things off in the first place. If you're going to explain what happened, be honest, be direct. Skirting around the issue would likely only raise further confusion. He may not reciprocate those feelings and that's okay. You can look for someone new and you'll now have a better idea of what you're looking for in a boyfriend.
